en: A colorized old postcard view of a wide cobblestone street lined with substantial townhouses and brick walls on both sides. There are gas or early electric streetlamps, horse-drawn vehicles in the distance, and a few pedestrians, including two children on the right foreground. The sky is bright blue with scattered white clouds. At the top of the image, printed text identifies the place as 'Limbach i. Sa.' on the left and 'Bahnhofstrasse.' on the right.
